feeds.title: The Survival Gardener
feeds.description: The Survival Gardener.com is the official gardening blog of author David The Good. It's all about growing the most food for the least amount of work. If you want to know how to garden and feed your family no matter what happens, this site is for you.

feeds.title: Montgomery Botanical Gardens News
feeds.description: News from the Montgomery Botanical Gardens. The mission of the Montgomery Botanical Gardens at Oak Park is to develop a stellar botanical garden for inspiration, education, and enrichment.

feeds.title: Billy Angell's Oak Street Garden Shop and Local Market Blog
feeds.description: Gardening tips from Oak Street Garden. Billy Angell's Oak Street Garden Shop and Local Market specializes in container gardening, arrangements, herbs, and a wide variety of annuals & perennials.

feeds.title: Flower Magazine » Gardens
feeds.description: The following section of Flower Magazine is dedicated to gardens and garden design. Flower magazine inspires, educates, and entertains readers with a point of view that stems from seeing the world through a botanical lens.

feeds.title: Birmingham Home & Garden » Gardens
feeds.description: Birmingham Home and Garden celebrates inspired living for Birmingham and beyond featuring beautiful homes, gardens, and the lives that create them.

feeds.title: Alabama Gardener
feeds.description: Alabama Gardener is a place where creativity has met innovation to provide grounded and tried and true insight into all things gardening! We offer a wide variety of content that focuses on gardening, harvesting, preserving, and tools. In addition, we stay up to date on the latest trends, technological developments, and tools that make life easier!

feeds.title: Deb's Garden
feeds.description: My name is Deborah Elliott. I am married to Lou, and we have three grown sons. I have learned everything I know about gardening from books and journals, other gardeners, and the hard master of trial and error. The purpose of this blog is to share my garden and to offer inspiration and advice to other gardeners.

feeds.title: Yard and Garage » Gardening
feeds.description: Yard and Garage can help you master the art of gardening and taking care of your plants, indoors and out. We provide information on a variety of topics such as organic gardening, outside decor or even how to bring your garden inside. Whether you're looking for serenity or a way to produce your own fruits and vegetables, we're here to help.
